newsitem.title: TUNISIA: German Schichau Seebeck launches Tunisian vessel.
newsitem.headline: German Schichau Seebeck launches Tunisian vessel.

text.p: Germany's Schichau Seebeck Werft has launched the wagoner vessel it built for Compagnie Tunisienne de Navigation, the Tunisian company said on Monday.

The "Ulysse", with an estimated cost of 64 million dinars ($64 million), is expected to begin service by the end of June and will link Tunisia to Mediterranean ports in France, Italy and Spain, state-owned company CTN said.
The vessel, launched on Saturday, has a capacity of 1,950 linear meters and a speed of up to 20 knots.

It is the first of two vessels to be delivered to CTN under a 1995 deal worth 138 million dinars with Schichau Seebeck Werft. The second one is expected to be delivered by the end of September, CTN said.
Tunisian Foreign Minister Abderrahim Zouari and his German counterpart Klaus Kinkel attended the launch at Bremerhaven in northern Germany.
